Our primary evaluation metrics are Recall@K and mean Recall@K (mRecall@K). Additionally, we propose another task of relation classification that calculates the top-1 predicate accuracy (Acc) for samples labeled with non-background relations, where we focus on the ability of model on predicting the relation given a pair of objects in the scene.
